description: This file contains JavaScript functions for project creation and UI interactions within the SuiteCRM module 'AM_ProjectTemplates'. It includes validation, dialog handling, and UI toggle functions.

methods.name: checkLength
methods.description: Validates if the length of a form field value is within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: checkRegexp
methods.description: Validates if a form field value matches a given regular expression.

methods.name: updateTips
methods.description: Displays validation tips with highlight effect.

methods.name: confirmation
methods.description: Handles the project creation confirmation dialog, including form validation and UI updates.
